p01-dog.observed_description: One medium-size golden-tan dog with a white chest patch, floppy ears and a plain red collar sits upright on a beige woven rug in a bright living room, body in side view and head turned toward the camera, eyes open, mouth closed. A grey sofa and a window are softly blurred behind. No other animal, person, food, bowl or toy. In the centered 4:5 crop the dog stays whole except the curled tip of its tail.
p01-dog.note: Usable: unmistakably a dog at every size down to 180 px; sitting still, so it cannot be read as running, sleeping, eating or playing.

p02-cat.observed_description: One grey tabby cat with dark stripes, a white chest, white front paws, green eyes and a plain blue collar sits upright on a worn wooden floor in a bright hallway, facing the camera with ears up and eyes wide open, tail curled around its feet. A plain wall and a white door frame are softly blurred behind. No other animal, person, food or toy. Whole inside the centered 4:5 crop.
p02-cat.note: Usable: unmistakably a cat at every size down to 180 px; awake and sitting, so it cannot be read as sleeping.

p03-bird.observed_description: One parakeet with a yellow head, green body, black-and-yellow striped wings and a long dark-blue tail perches on a plain wooden T-shaped perch on a wooden table in a bright living room, in clear side view with beak, eye, wing, both feet and tail visible. A sofa, a potted plant on a windowsill and a bookshelf are softly blurred behind; book spines show no readable text. No cage, bars, food or water. In the centered 4:5 crop the bird stays whole except the last part of its long tail.
p03-bird.note: Usable: unmistakably a bird at every size down to 180 px; no dish or food, so it cannot be read as drinking or eating.

p04-rabbit.observed_description: One white rabbit with light-brown patches on its back and around its eyes and two long upright ears sits on all four feet on a light wooden floor in a bright room, in side-front view with a dark eye and pink nose visible. A plain cream wall and the corner of a grey rug are softly blurred behind. No other animal, person, food or bowl. In the centered 4:5 crop both ears and the face stay whole and only the rump is trimmed.
p04-rabbit.note: Usable: the long upright ears make it unmistakably a rabbit at every size down to 180 px; no food, so it cannot be read as eating.

p05-dog-running.observed_description: The same golden-tan dog with the white chest patch and plain red collar runs across a short green lawn in a sunny garden, in side view moving right: front legs lifted in mid-stride, ears flying back, mouth open with the tongue visible, tail stretched out behind. A wooden fence and flowering bushes are softly blurred behind. No ball, toy, leash, person or other animal. In the centered 4:5 crop the body, legs and head stay in view and only the nose tip and the tail are trimmed.
p05-dog-running.note: Usable: running reads at every size down to 180 px (lifted legs, flying ears, open mouth, lawn); nothing to play with, so it is not playing.

p06-cat-sleeping.observed_description: The same grey tabby cat with the white front paws and plain blue collar sleeps curled in a ball on a cream sofa cushion in a bright living room: both eyes fully closed, head resting on its front paws, tail wrapped around its body. A window and wooden floor are softly blurred behind. No other animal, person, food or toy. In the centered 4:5 crop the closed eyes and face stay whole and only the back of the body is trimmed.
p06-cat-sleeping.note: Usable: sleeping reads at every size down to 180 px (curled body, closed eyes).

p07-bird-drinking.observed_description: The same yellow-headed green parakeet stands on the rim of a small plain white dish filled with clear water on a wooden table and leans forward with its beak touching the water; ripples spread from the beak. A window with potted plants and a bookshelf are softly blurred behind; no readable text. The dish holds only water: no seeds, food or fruit. In the centered 4:5 crop the head, beak and dish stay whole and only the tail is trimmed.
p07-bird-drinking.note: Usable: the lowered beak in the water and the ripples read as drinking down to 180 px; no food anywhere, so it is not eating.

p08-rabbit-eating.observed_description: The same white rabbit with light-brown patches and two long upright ears sits on a light wooden floor in a bright living room and holds a green lettuce leaf in its mouth, chewing; two more lettuce leaves and one orange carrot lie on the floor in front of it. A light sofa, a rug and a window are softly blurred behind. No water bowl or bottle, no other animal or person. In the centered 4:5 crop the ears, face and the leaf in the mouth stay whole.
p08-rabbit-eating.note: Usable: the leaf in the mouth and the food on the floor read as eating down to 180 px; no water, so it is not drinking.

p09-pets-group.observed_description: Four pets in one row on a beige rug in a bright living room, all facing the camera: from left to right the golden-tan dog with the red collar sitting upright, the grey tabby cat with the blue collar sitting upright, the white rabbit with light-brown patches and upright ears, and the yellow-headed green parakeet on a low wooden perch stand. A grey sofa and curtained windows are softly blurred behind; a small picture frame at the top right edge shows nothing readable. No people, food, toys or cage. The centered 4:5 crop cuts the dog in half and loses the bird, so this photo is not for a four-picture grid.
p09-pets-group.note: Usable in 3:2 only (declared four_card false): all four animals are distinct at every size down to 180 px.

p10-girl-dog-playing.observed_description: On a sunny garden lawn the family's girl (about seven, long dark hair in a ponytail, lilac T-shirt, blue jeans) kneels and holds a plain orange ball high in her right hand, laughing, face in profile to three-quarter view; the golden-tan dog with the white chest and red collar stands on its hind legs facing her with its front paws in the air and its mouth open, jumping for the ball. Flower beds and trees are softly blurred behind. Only this girl and this dog; nothing is written on the ball. Her raised hand grips the ball naturally and her other hand rests on her thigh with natural fingers. Both stay in view in the centered 4:5 crop, with the dog's tail and the girl's back trimmed.
p10-girl-dog-playing.note: Usable: the girl, the dog and the ball game read as playing together at every size down to 180 px. Her hair is in a full ponytail, not half up as in the reference; her face and T-shirt match.
